Admissions Open: Fall 2026 (Phase-II) — University of Loralai

Executive Summary

"The University of Loralai announces Admissions Open for Fall 2026 (Phase-II) across undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs. Last date to apply is October 25, 2026."

UNIVERSITY OF LORALAI — ADMISSIONS OPEN | FALL 2026 (PHASE-II)

The University of Loralai announces Admissions Open for Fall 2026 (Phase-II) in a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs.

📚 Programs Offered Include

  • Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT)
  • BS Anesthesia Technology
  • BS Optometry
  • BS Business Administration
  • BS Commerce
  • BS Economics with Data Science
  • BS Education
  • BS English
  • BS Financial Technology
  • BS Islamic Studies
  • BS Mathematics
  • BS Pashto
  • BS Political Science
  • BS Zoology
  • PhD Education
  • MS Management Sciences
  • M.Phil Education
  • B.Ed programs and other eligible programs

✨ Why Choose University of Loralai? - HEC-Recognized Degree Programs - Experienced & Dedicated Faculty - Affordable Fee Structure - Digital Libraries & Smart Classrooms - Scholarships & Financial Aid - Secure & Peaceful Campus Environment - Research, Innovation & Community Engagement - High-Speed Campus-Wide Wi-Fi - State-of-the-Art Sports Facilities

🔴 LAST DATE: October 25, 2026 (DATE EXTENDED — PHASE-II)

📝 How to Apply

  • Admission forms and eligibility criteria are available at: www.uoli.edu.pk

💰 Application Processing Fee

  • PhD / MS / M.Phil: Rs. 3,000/-
  • BS, DPT, Allied Sciences & B.Ed: Rs. 2,000/-
